name: Twilio SendGrid
shortDescription: SendGrid provides mail send APIs, templates, contacts, stats, webhooks, suppression lists, and scheduling.
agentSummary: Agents can send transactional email and manage templates/lists when domains and approvals are configured.
bestFor: Transactional email, marketing sends, templates, suppression management, and delivery analytics.
cautionNotes: Key limitations: Outbound email can damage sender reputation; use review, test addresses, and unsubscribe safeguards. Outbound messages, SMS, email deliverability, consent, unsubscribe behavior, private chats, and customer-facing replies need approval, throttling, and audit logs. API automation needs client-side throttling, idempotency where supported, pagination limits, retries, and audit logging. Account setup or elevated access may require vendor, admin, or compliance approval before an agent can operate independently.
pricingSummary: Public plan pricing by email volume and feature set.
authModel: API keys with scopes, sender/domain authentication, webhooks.
browserSupport: Console helps review sender auth, templates, stats, and suppression lists.

capabilities.detail: Mail Send API and v3 APIs cover email sending, templates, contacts, and stats.
Docs cover API reference, scheduling, webhooks, and delivery concepts.
Pricing is public by email volume and product.
Console helps review sender auth, templates, stats, and suppression lists.
